name: Season Two, 2026
description: Thirteen Saturday sessions, 26 September to 19 December 2026, each at 11:00 Pacific time. Each week names the canvas blocks it works on, and the Canvas view puts those blocks first. Every block stays open every week.

weeks.title: Selection Day
tools: The Governance Canvas public notebook (a link, read before the session)
actions: On paper, give each block one word for how it stands today.
Draft one line saying what the project is for.
Collect each founder's email, the village's slug and its timezone.

weeks.title: Incubator Overview
tools: Canvas baseline (Journey to Launch, Canvas view)
Canvas resources, on paper from the Governance Canvas sheet
weeks.showcaseAsk: The purpose draft, in words only. Is this honest?
actions: Claim the instance, then set its timezone and currency.
Set the first season's dates. A season ending at the 20 March 2027 equinox keeps every seat and care term clear of the holiday week.
Write the purpose draft into the village brief (aims).
Take the first reading of all twelve blocks on the Canvas view: one word and one sentence for each.
Each founder says what they bring and what they will hand over.

weeks.title: Game and Organisation Co-Creation 1
tools: Role cards on the Roles page
weeks.showcaseAsk: The role map. Could a newcomer find where they fit without taking over?
actions: Write the village's role cards on the Roles page.
Name the intake role and a cover role for it.
Write down the village's values and the words it uses for itself.

weeks.title: Game and Organisation Co-Creation 2
weeks.showcaseAsk: Who decides what, how is it challenged, and what would a new member do on a bad day?
actions: Switch governance on for members, then hold one practice vote.
Write the restorative steps in the village's own words, with a live intake holder and the cohort ombuds named.
Write how the village consults and informs in the decisions section of the brief.

weeks.title: Game Guides and Economic Systems
tools: Test Run on Journey to Launch
Database toolkits, on paper for now
weeks.showcaseAsk: Could another project run this play?
actions: Switch the Tools Hub on.
Run the Test Run and read what the village's settings would do.
Draft one public line for each block.

weeks.title: Growing Your Village
weeks.showcaseAsk: What happens the first time two members fall out?
actions: Walk through how someone joins the village and how someone leaves it well.
Role-play a made-up tension through the restorative steps.
Propose practice quests.

weeks.title: Ecosystem and the Fund
weeks.showcaseAsk: Who has a stake who is not in the room?
actions: Fill in Work With Us for the partners the village wants.
Name everyone with a stake in the village who is not in the room.
Offer resources back to the canvas library only once its contribution form keeps contributors' emails private.

weeks.title: Tokenomics 1
weeks.showcaseAsk: Where does value come from, and where does it go?
actions: Run the Test Run again with this week's settings.

weeks.title: Tokenomics 2
tools: Health module, if the village chooses it
actions: Decide the issuance cap on Journey to Launch, or decline it there.

weeks.title: Legal Structures 1
weeks.showcaseAsk: What protects the purpose if the founders leave?
actions: Name the jurisdiction first.
Name the entity, or write none yet with a plan and a date.

weeks.title: Legal Structures 2
weeks.showcaseAsk: Can someone leave well, and is our consequences ladder lawful here?
actions: Read the land tenure against how the village runs.
Check the exit terms against the legal shape.
Adopt the conflict agreement, with a review date at least one moon after the last session.

weeks.title: Coordination and Minimum Viable Economies
weeks.showcaseAsk: What changed in how you work, in your own words?
actions: Take the season reading of all twelve blocks. It stays in the village.
Re-seat: care and cover terms run at least one moon past the last session.
Rehearse member onboarding and the care path.
Each founder says what they will hand over.

weeks.title: Crowd Pooling and Resourcing
actions: Configure the crowdpool.
Welcome newcomers into the village.

moons.note: The first canvas moon. Hold it inside the week 3 session, or on Sunday 11 October, and take a new reading of any block that has moved since the baseline.
The second canvas moon. Take a new reading of any block that has moved.
Before you raise: read power, resourcing, legal and impact again before any funding ask.
